name: Odesa City Hall
scope: The exterior of the former Old Stock Exchange, now Odesa City Hall, including the Dumska Square colonnade, clock attic, paired side blocks, curved rear bay and attached long wing.
era: The standing historic civic exterior reflecting the 1871–1873 reconstruction of the former exchange.

originalReview.notes: The exact published Qualla original matches the single full photographer upload and its first-revision self-release. Architectural details visible include the rows of columns and white lattice parapet, clock surround and front stairs.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Exact public-domain published Qualla frontage photograph plus the institution’s descriptions and mapped exterior footprint. Heights and the less photographed rear elevation are reconstructed estimates.
